faq_heading: Port Moody and Anmore schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 12 schools with a Port Moody and Anmore street address: 12 public schools and 0 independent schools.
Public schools here are run by School District 43 (Coquitlam). Count by district: School District 43 (Coquitlam): 12.

The list includes alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address, so the totals run higher than the number of neighbourhood schools. The Ministry's own level field also mislabels some secondary schools as elementary, so this page reads the level from the school's name.

If you are buying with a child in mind, the address matters more than the list. A school's catchment decides which children it must take, and districts change catchments and set their own rules for French immersion and other programs. Ask the district about the exact address before you write an offer.
Port Moody and Anmore are separate municipalities that share a school district, so they share this list.

blocks.text: Licensed childcare in Port Moody and Anmore

The Ministry's Child Care Map registry lists 49 licensed childcare facilities with a Port Moody and Anmore address: 36 licensed group and 13 licensed family. The registry covers licensed care only. Care that does not need a licence is not listed by address, so a family may find more options than this count suggests. Names and addresses change often, so check the registry before you rely on any one facility.

faq.q: How many schools are in Port Moody and Anmore, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 12 schools with a Port Moody and Anmore street address: 12 public schools and 0 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Port Moody and Anmore?
faq.a: Public schools with a Port Moody and Anmore address are run by School District 43 (Coquitlam).

faq.q: How do I find which school a home is zoned for?
faq.a: Ask the school district to confirm the catchment school for the exact street address. Catchments change, and living near a school does not guarantee a place at it.
